description: This file declares the interface for a Merger class responsible for merging and reading chunked protobuf messages in TensorFlow's proto_splitter tool. It includes methods for merging chunks, reading protobufs from disk or strings, and processing chunked protobuf fields, indicating its role in handling protobuf message merging and I/O operations within the project.

classes.name: Merger
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to merge, read, and process chunked protobuf messages, facilitating protobuf message assembly and I/O operations within the TensorFlow proto_splitter tool.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges multiple protobuf message chunks into a single message, using a specified chunked message as context.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a chunked protobuf from a specified filesystem prefix into a protobuf message.

methods.name: ReadPartial
methods.description: Reads part of a chunked protobuf, constrained by chunk metadata.

methods.name: ReadChunkedFromString
methods.description: Deserializes a chunked protobuf from a raw string into a protobuf message.

methods.name: ReadPb
methods.description: Reads a standard saved_model protobuf file from disk into a message.

methods.name: ReadFields
methods.description: Processes and populates a protobuf message using chunked message metadata and data reader.

methods.name: ProcessField
methods.description: Handles individual chunked fields within a message, recursively processing nested chunked messages or adding fields via reflection.
